docs.title: 400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

skip.reason: Rust/Python/Kotlin/C#'s FilePurpose enum rejects invalid values at deserialization (Jackson in Kotlin, FilePurposeJsonConverter in C#) before reaching the HTTP layer, so no 400 is ever observed

error.message: Invalid value for 'purpose': 'invalid-purpose'. Supported values are: 'fine-tune', 'assistants', 'batch'.
